env.label: shared CI VM - noisy, for relative comparison
env.build: CMake Release, cmake version 4.5.0, GitHub-hosted macOS runner (macos26 20261117.0516.1)
env.build_facts: optimized, NDEBUG, stdio: macOS libc, tblog: static library

config.e2e_definition: tblog: start until tblog_shutdown() returns (drain + fsync + close); fprintf: start until fflush + fsync + fclose return

variants.fprintf_buffered: fprintf to one shared FILE* opened "wb", default stdio buffering (the C library locks the stream per call)
variants.snprintf_fwrite: snprintf of the same line into a stack buffer + one fwrite to the shared FILE* (default buffering)
variants.tblog_block: TBLOG_INFO, default config except file only (console=false, reload.watch=false, file.max_size=4GB), full_policy=block (the default)
variants.tblog_drop: TBLOG_INFO, default config except file only (console=false, reload.watch=false, file.max_size=4GB), full_policy=drop
variants.printf_if_guard: if (atomic<bool> debug_enabled /* false */) fprintf(...): the filtered printf call
variants.tblog_below_level: TBLOG_DEBUG(...) with level = INFO: the filtered tblog call
variants.tblog_flush_error_0pct: tblog_block + flush.on_level=ERROR; 0% of the lines are TBLOG_ERROR (evenly spread), the rest TBLOG_INFO
variants.tblog_flush_error_1pct: tblog_block + flush.on_level=ERROR; 1% of the lines are TBLOG_ERROR (evenly spread), the rest TBLOG_INFO
variants.tblog_flush_error_10pct: tblog_block + flush.on_level=ERROR; 10% of the lines are TBLOG_ERROR (evenly spread), the rest TBLOG_INFO
variants.tblog_flush_error_100pct: tblog_block + flush.on_level=ERROR; 100% of the lines are TBLOG_ERROR (evenly spread), the rest TBLOG_INFO
variants.tblog_flush_error_nosync_0pct: tblog_block + flush.on_level=ERROR + sync.on_level=OFF; 0% of the lines are TBLOG_ERROR (evenly spread), the rest TBLOG_INFO
variants.tblog_flush_error_nosync_1pct: tblog_block + flush.on_level=ERROR + sync.on_level=OFF; 1% of the lines are TBLOG_ERROR (evenly spread), the rest TBLOG_INFO
variants.tblog_flush_error_nosync_10pct: tblog_block + flush.on_level=ERROR + sync.on_level=OFF; 10% of the lines are TBLOG_ERROR (evenly spread), the rest TBLOG_INFO
variants.tblog_flush_error_nosync_100pct: tblog_block + flush.on_level=ERROR + sync.on_level=OFF; 100% of the lines are TBLOG_ERROR (evenly spread), the rest TBLOG_INFO
